notes.en:
Fixed: Gateway failing to start after packaged installation — the kernel boundary patch (openRootFile) inside the asar bundle returned an undefined path parameter, crashing the 2026.8.2 kernel's startup chain; present since v2026.811.8 but never caught because dev verification always ran in loose-file mode. Fixed, with new asar-form smoke tests to prevent regression
Fixed: Gateway never becoming ready ("migration not converged" loop) when an incompletely installed extension (e.g. a skill-only plugin with no runnable payload) is present — unavailable plugins are now auto-disabled at startup with their config preserved; reinstall from the extension store anytime to restore

notes.en:
Fixed: QQ channel crash-looping on the 2026.8.2 kernel — the official qqbot plugin's import "ws" hits the ws package's ESM wrapper (wrapper.mjs), whose CJS interop fails under the new kernel's plugin loading chain (permessage-deflate ... no export named 'default'), killing the channel every 5 minutes; qqbot is now force-rebundled single-file at build time (ws statically inlined), verified stable against the live QQ gateway
Fixed: WeCom/WeChat plugins failing to load (Dynamic require of "crypto") — esbuild ESM output now carries a createRequire/__dirname compatibility banner; plugin entry patching also rewrites runtimeExtensions, and bundles carry a content marker so stale outputs are rebuilt automatically
Fixed: stale plugin copies never refreshed for existing users — the mirror-plugin reconcile signature upgraded from entry-path-only to path + content hash, so a broken same-name bundle gets replaced
Improved: deduplication — jscpd duplication 1.15% → 0.88% (79→64 clones): shared helpers for the webbridge repair tail/precheck assembly, one skill-mutation helper, channel settings tabs' boilerplate converged into the shared module, message-body rendering/session adoption/URL param helpers deduped
Docs: docs/ cleanup — historical plans and superseded designs archived under docs/archive/, new docs/README.md index; stale facts corrected across CLAUDE.md, gotchas, ipc-api, client-ticker and README (Electron version, update channel, theme color, blockmap, etc.)

安全：修复 25 个依赖漏洞（含打包链路的严重级 node-tar 路径穿越；chat-ui 侧 dompurify/vite 等 7 项清零）

notes.en:
Reading experience: markdown headings in chat get a proper type scale, and GFM tables are now styled (borders, padding, zebra rows) with horizontal scroll instead of breaking the bubble
New: markdown engine renders GFM task lists (- [x] as read-only checkboxes); parse failures degrade to plain text instead of breaking the message
Security: fixed 25 dependency vulnerabilities (incl. critical node-tar path traversal in the packaging chain; chat-ui dompurify/vite etc. all cleared)
Engineering: new tests CI workflow (full regression on every commit); removed upstream signing/CDN release workflows that don't apply to this fork

notes.zh:
新功能：模型管理支持自定义分组——新建/重命名/删除/拖拽排序分组，把模型指派进组后，聊天与定时任务的模型选择器按分组显示

优化：模型选择器中默认模型带「默认」标记，多模型时更容易辨认
notes.en:
New: custom groups in model management — create/rename/delete/drag-reorder groups, assign models to them, and the model selector in chat and scheduled tasks displays them as sections
Improved: model management page gains a search box (filter by name/ID) and inline Default / Fallback N badges on model cards
Improved: the default model is labeled in the model selector for easier recognition

notes.zh:
全新版本：更名 CryoClaw，启用全新冰蓝视觉设计（浅色/暗色双主题）
新功能：模型管理重构——provider 分组、密钥真实有效性探测、备用模型（fallback）配置
新功能：终端会话列表与用量展示接入实时事件推送，状态更新更及时
优化：对话流式渲染改为逐帧纯文本渲染，长回复不再越滚越卡；完整排版在回复结束时一次性呈现
优化：折叠的工具调用区域首次展开才渲染，长会话滚动与切换明显更轻快
优化：存储裁剪——移除非本机平台原生依赖、插件冗余类型声明与前端 sourcemap，应用体积显著缩小

修复：诊断日志改为异步写盘，主进程不再因高频日志卡顿
notes.en:
New era: renamed to CryoClaw with an all-new ice-blue visual design (light/dark themes)
New: rebuilt model management — provider grouping, real API-key validation, fallback model configuration
New: terminal session list and usage now update via realtime events
Improved: streaming replies render per-frame as plain text — long answers no longer degrade; full formatting applied once when the reply finishes
Improved: collapsed tool-call sections render lazily on first expand — long sessions scroll and switch noticeably faster
Improved: storage trimming — removed off-platform native deps, redundant plugin type declarations and frontend sourcemaps, significantly smaller app size
Improved: official plugin updates (Feishu/QQ Bot etc.); kimi-claw plugin removed, replaced by built-in features
Fixed: diagnostic logging is now asynchronous — no more main-process hiccups under heavy logging

notes.zh:
修复：技能提案（Apply workspace skill proposal）审批现在会直接显示在对话框上方，可批准/拒绝（此前只进设置页历史，70 秒超时后必然失败）

安全修复：安装包不再误打包 .env.build 构建配置、.cache 调试缓存与重复资源（安装包体积减半，回归 ~134MB）
优化：侧栏会话菜单靠近底部时自动向上展开；多条审批并存时审批面板限高可滚动；顶部提示条让开标题栏并限宽

notes.en:
Fix: skill proposal approvals (Apply workspace skill proposal) now appear above the composer with approve/deny (previously only logged in Settings, always expiring after 70s)
Fix: plan floating panel moved down, no longer overlapping window min/max/close buttons
Fix: tool-output sidebar header and top error banner no longer hidden under the title bar; tasks view top padding aligned
Security: installer no longer bundles .env.build, .cache debug data or duplicated resources (installer size halved, back to ~134MB)
Improve: sidebar session menu flips upward near the bottom; approval panel is height-capped and scrollable; top toasts clear the title bar and are width-capped

notes.zh:
新功能：任务进行时发送的消息进入队列，队列消息现在可编辑、可删除、可点「立即发送」插队

notes.en:
New: messages sent during a run are queued — queue items can now be edited, deleted, or sent immediately
New: a notice appears when the model falls back to a backup model, and when it recovers
Improved: Stop and Send buttons now coexist during a run (send = enqueue); clearer queue hint
Security: API keys are masked in settings; unchanged keys are never re-sent; config API no longer returns plaintext keys
Improved: run failures show only the inline warning card (no more duplicate banner + card)
Improved: all native confirm dialogs replaced with the app's own style (danger actions get a red confirm)

notes.en:
